2610.11380.title: Equal Path Cost, Unequal Output Effects: Understanding Perturbation Propagation in Diffusion Models
2610.11380.paper_summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, with their sampling procedures routinely modified to control generation and improve efficiency. These modifications introduce perturbations along the sampling trajectory, raising a central question: how do such perturbations affect generated output? To address this question, we develop a theoretical framework to investigate perturbation propagation, combining dynamical analysis of the sampling process with an information-theoretic characterization of output responses. Within this framework, we quantify perturbation strength using the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between perturbed and reference trajectory distributions, termed as path cost, which is shown to bound, but do not determine, changes in the output distribution. Building on this analysis, we derive a response identity that connects the propagation and accumulation of local perturbations with the information captured by a selected feature mean, explaining why changes in the output distribution can remain undetected by its first-order response. We test our theoretical analysis through controlled interventions at equal path cost in pretrained diffusion models, revealing distinct patterns of output sensitivity across sampling stages and spatial frequencies. To assess whether our framework can diagnose perturbations arising from practical approximations, we apply it to cache-based acceleration and show that our propagation analysis reliably identifies sampling intervals where caching causes larger image errors.
2610.11380.paper_summary_zh: 擴散模型在生成建模方面取得了顯著的成功，其採樣程序經常被修改以控制生成並提高效率。這些修改在採樣軌跡上引入了擾動，提出了一個核心問題：這些擾動如何影響生成的輸出？為了解決這個問題，我們開發了一個理論框架來研究擾動的傳播，將採樣過程的動態分析與輸出響應的信息論特徵相結合。在這個框架內，我們使用Kullback--Leibler (KL) 散度來量化擾動強度，這是擾動和參考軌跡分佈之間的差異，稱為路徑成本，這已被證明可以界定但不決定輸出分佈的變化。在此分析的基礎上，我們推導出一個響應恆等式，將局部擾動的傳播和積累與所選特徵均值所捕獲的信息聯繫起來，解釋了為什麼輸出分佈的變化可能在其一階響應中未被檢測到。我們通過在預訓練的擴散模型中進行等路徑成本的控制干預來測試我們的理論分析，揭示了在採樣階段和空間頻率之間的輸出敏感性存在明顯的模式。為了評估我們的框架是否能診斷出來自實際近似的擾動，我們將其應用於基於緩存的加速，並顯示我們的傳播分析可靠地識別出緩存導致較大圖像誤差的採樣區間。
